signals.name: ALARM
signals.description: PB0, high while any alarm is active

signals.name: STROBE
signals.description: PA8 via 1 kOhm: the node's strobe, or a data-ready line the pod drives

signals.name: SENSOR_UART_RX
signals.description: PC10 USART3 TX -> pod (emulated UART sensor)

signals.name: SENSOR_UART_TX
signals.description: pod -> PC11 USART3 RX (emulated UART sensor)

signals.name: SENSOR_SPI_SCK
signals.description: PB13 SPI2 SCK (emulated SPI sensor, the node drives)

signals.name: SENSOR_SPI_MISO
signals.description: PB14 SPI2 MISO (the pod drives, only while CS is low)
